candidates.angle: Krishna is easy to reach for the one-pointed yogi
candidates.evidence: तस्याहं सुलभः पार्थ नित्ययुक्तस्य योगिनः (for that yogi I am easy to reach)

candidates.angle: the yogi who remembers me constantly
candidates.evidence: सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः (who always remembers me constantly)

angle_en: Easy to reach for the one-pointed yogi

en.intro: After telling Arjuna how to leave the body, Krishna steps back to describe the living path of devotion. Listen for the condition that makes him easy to reach.
en.notice: Krishna says he is easy to reach, sudhalam, for the yogi who is nitya-yuktasya, ever-joined, and whose mind is ananya-cetah, one-pointed, so that his remembrance is constant.
en.next: He then says that great souls who reach him do not return to this cycle of birth.
en.meaning: Arjuna, for the one whose mind is wholly on me and who remembers me constantly, I am easy to reach.

hi.intro: शरीर त्यागने का तरीका बताने के बाद, कृष्ण भक्तियोग का मार्ग बताते हैं। सुनिए कि किन शर्तों पर वे सुलभ हो जाते हैं।
hi.meaning: हे पृथानन्दन, जो मनुष्य अनन्यचित्त होकर मेरा नित्यनिरन्तर स्मरण करता है, उस नित्ययुक्त योगी के लिए मैं सुलभ हूँ, अर्थात् उसको सुलभतासे प्राप्त हो जाता हूँ।
hi.notice: कृष्ण कहते हैं कि जो योगी नित्ययुक्त है और जिसका मन अनन्यचेता है, उसके लिए वे सुलभ हैं, क्योंकि उसका स्मरण सतत और नित्यशः है।
hi.next: वे आगे कहते हैं कि जो महात्मे मुझे प्राप्त करते हैं, वे इस जन्म-मरण के चक्र में वापस नहीं आते।

en.intro: After telling Arjuna how to leave the body, Krishna steps back to describe the living path of devotion. Listen for the condition that makes him easy to reach.
en.body: Arjuna, for the one whose mind is wholly on me and who remembers me constantly, I am easy to reach. Krishna says he is easy to reach, sudhalam, for the yogi who is nitya-yuktasya, ever-joined, and whose mind is ananya-cetah, one-pointed, so that his remembrance is constant. He then says that great souls who reach him do not return to this cycle of birth.

issues: meaning_changed: "हे पृथानन्दन" (The source Hindi translation begins with 'हे पृथानन्दन' (O Delighter of the Earth), but the app's Hindi intro, meaning, and notice completely omit this vocative address to Arjuna. This drops a key part of the original verse's direct address.)

meaning_changed: "अर्थात् उसको सुलभतासे प्राप्त हो जाता हूँ ॥" (The source Hindi translation includes the explanatory phrase 'अर्थात् उसको सुलभतासे प्राप्त हो जाता हूँ' (meaning he becomes easy to attain). The app's Hindi meaning omits this explanatory clause, thereby softening the explicit declaration of Krishna's accessibility.)
